title: Typed property values
statement: The system shall store node and edge property values with explicit types, including int64, double, decimal128, timestamp, binary, list and record, without loss of precision on round trip.
rationale: Plain JSON loses integer precision beyond 2^53 and has no decimal type.

acceptance_criteria.text: Writing and reading back int64 values ±(2^63−1) and decimal128 values returns identical values and types.
Property values nested up to 100 levels round-trip unchanged.
